character.name: Zero
character.portraitAlt: Zero with shortened auburn hair and trimmed beard in navy, gold and white Yardrat clothing with a lavender sash.
character.origin: From a world where Dragon Ball is fiction. The cause of the crossing is still unknown.
character.appearance: Approximately 5′8″ (173 cm), muscular build, shortened copper-auburn waves, trimmed beard and normally green irises. Navy-and-gold asymmetric Yardrat tunic, white sleeves and trousers, lavender sash and matching boots. The black seal with four inward-curving hooks remains below the sternum. Sealed Channel gives red irises and a pale violet aura.
character.personality: Expressed through your choices and dialogue.
character.backstory: Familiar with Dragon Ball through anime, manga, films and games before the crossing. No further personal background is recorded.
character.arrival: Woke outside Capsule Corp in West City with an unfamiliar athletic body and new clothes. Nappa’s attack left him critically injured. Vegeta intervened, arranged evacuation and later proved to be a Time Patroller. Zero gave his name before losing consciousness. Zero later chose 1 January, the Conton-calendar arrival anniversary, as his birthday. His adopted age anchor is 26 years and 6 months at arrival; personal ageing includes chamber time.
character.motivation: Continue developing independent strength and prepare the integration wish using the completed compatible Dragon Ball set.
character.knowledge: Retains Dragon Ball media knowledge without knowing every alternate history. Chronoa confirmed the Xenoverse stories correspond to the Patrol’s past. Zero knows the Dark Factor can take bodily control and that Kaioken destabilises its opened seal; its identity and the cause of his crossing remain unknown. He and Yamcha revived Krillin, Roshi, Tien and Chiaotzu in TL-503, then returned for a full conditional-history review. That course includes Namek/Yardrat training and a destructive Android crisis in Ages 767–768. Six weeks under a resident King Kai developed Kaioken, sensing and a small Spirit Bomb exercise. Zero defeated fruit-enhanced Nappa on Namek in TL-619, was rescued from Turles by Vegeta and Yamcha, and heard the completed mission review. He has disclosed his integration-wish intention to Chronoa, who offered help with wording. Guru released Zero’s own potential with the seal closed; the first scan was 69,497. Yamcha and the three visiting native fighters also received releases. Four weeks of training with Nail brought Zero to 77,000 before returning to Conton. Zero and Yamcha captured Brask and Rivet on TL-846 and secured their weapons and shuttle. The ship used a booked external passage; its operator remains unidentified. Continued training with Vegeta, King Kai and Yamcha brought Zero to 79,807. Hercule confirmed 100% integrity before departure. Zero and Yamcha have since arrived on Yardrat, reunited with Bulma, Krillin, Tien and Chiaotzu, and met Pybara and his assistant. Their friends arrived four days before them. A month of intensive Yardrat instruction has developed Mastered Ki Control, Advanced Instant Transmission and sensing, and Proficient Cloning, Gigantification and Spirit Healing. Spirit Control is the Yardratian approach to Ki Control; each application is practised separately. Two further fortnights completed the Yardrat stay. Yamcha achieved Alpha, and both refined all four Yardrat applications. Hercule traced Nappa and Turles to an expedition after they directed native Frieza toward Earth’s Dragon Balls. Integrity last read 86%. The fighters returned to Earth by Instant Transmission; Frieza’s fleet arrived shortly afterwards. Zero defeated the native Ginyu Force and destroyed the flagship, then was badly injured by final-form Frieza. Vegeta arrived, revealed True Wrathful and killed Frieza; surviving mobile forces fled. After returning to Conton and receiving medical care, Zero reviewed the changed Cold and Android course with Hercule. That review predates Yamcha’s subsequent visit to Bulma; no fresh future review or integrity reading has followed. Yamcha transferred into Vegeta’s team on 30 August. During the following month and week, Zero completed assigned team, duo and solo cleanup work and collected the remaining five compatible Dragon Balls. All seven are now owned; no wish has been made.
character.limitations: Assigned team and solo cleanup duties require dispatch approval; Vegeta leads the team. Kaioken x2 and Sealed Channel are separately usable; combining them remains unsafe. Advanced sensing gives approximate readable output. Instant Transmission needs a perceived living anchor. Spirit Spear requires contact and committed gathering; Spirit Bomb needs actual spirit-energy supply and concentration.

character.powerHistory: Guru’s individual ×12 release produced 69,497 on 22 May. Four weeks with Nail brought the base to 77,000; the Brask engagement and subsequent training led to 79,807 on 28 June. The following month of intensive Yardrat training brought the measured base to 97,079 on 28 July. Earlier readings remain dated in the journal. No repeated potential release, human Zenkai or automatic absorption of channel power. Form totals use the recorded integer base; they are not new transformed scans. Subsequent fortnight readings were 106,996 on 11 August and 118,354 on 25 August. Light preparation brought the ordinary reading to 118,366 on 27 August. Controlled training with Vegeta on 28 August brought two rested readings to 118,834 the following morning. Medical recovery itself granted no power increase. Routine practice and missions brought rested readings to 121,306 on 29 September and 121,802 on 6 October. The corrected month includes no injuries from the ×10-fruit Nappa encounter or forced base-only fight with the native Vegeta.

story.situation: The final Seven-Star Ball has been issued. Zero holds its case; the other six compatible balls are stored in Room 214. Yamcha is now part of Vegeta’s team.

abilities.title: Physical Combat
abilities.summary: Close-range strikes, from quick combinations to heavy blows.
abilities.development: Close-range defence, recovery under pressure and varied approaches developed in the latest Vegeta session.

trainingRecord.text: Earlier practice through 28 June, Age 854: Chamber benchmarks remain 75× gravity for ground rounds, 25× for aerial rounds and 150× for slow conditioning; no higher maximum has been established. Peer sparring and cleanup work developed group awareness. In TL-619, tight counters, accumulated damage and sustained pressure let Zero defeat a stronger Nappa while using the sealed channel. Vegeta remained far beyond him; their following training day focused on recovering after interrupted attacks, using separate channel bouts, closure and rest. Four weeks with Nail and the quarry fight developed aerial reversals, guarded combinations and sustained pressure against injured Brask. Subsequent Vegeta rounds improved close-range defence; he still controls their exchanges. Latest practice: 28 August, eight productive hours shared across physical combat, blasts and teleportation; physical work earned 72, with no tier change. S306 dedicated practice adds 160 progress; field use is not a duplicate award. Later dedicated practice through 5 October is included in the current progress total; mission use did not award additional mastery.

Neither the channel nor cooperative spirit-energy gathering has permanently absorbed another power into the base. Nail’s month of instruction and the latest King Kai sessions improved movement, transitions and recovery; no new gravity or endurance maximum was established.

trainingRecord.text: Earlier practice through 28 June, Age 854: Started with one small shot on Day 22. Chamber practice developed step-release, moving-target fire and short volleys while manoeuvring. Larger shots require an opening and consume more stamina; accuracy remains imperfect. These are ordinary ki attacks, not an acquired named beam or signature technique. In the mission he destroyed the warehouse with an outward release and used contact blasts and concentrated ki at his fingertips. No stable blade was acquired in that fight. During Yamcha’s Raditz fight, a precise shot destroyed the scouter with only superficial burns to Raditz, leaving Yamcha to win his own fight. On Namek, twenty ordinary shots followed preset wide curves; three hit Nappa from behind. This was limited curved fire, not homing or Yamcha’s Spirit Ball. Spirit Spear is recorded separately. Ordinary yellow beams destroyed the invasion craft on Earth. The 28 August Vegeta session added 36; these attacks remain ordinary Ki Blasts. S306 dedicated practice adds 160 progress; field use is not a duplicate award. abilities.title: Power suppression
abilities.summary: Lowers emitted power and deliberately releases it for action.
abilities.effect: Regulates how much ki is expressed and detectable.
abilities.control: Deliberate full-power bursts can be followed by renewed suppression. Hard surprises can disrupt the chosen level.
abilities.development: Intensive control practice strengthened suppression alongside deliberate changes in output.
abilities.artworkAlt: Lowers emitted power and deliberately releases it for action. Symbolic technique illustration.

trainingRecord.text: Self-taught in the chamber and checked with the scouter. The final test stayed near 1,538 through walking and a short combination, then returned deliberately to 3,075. Hard surprises can still cause spikes. Sleep and unconscious maintenance, perfect concealment and instant expert switching are not established. Suppression makes a given load harder; it does not multiply training gains. The opening soldier engagement demonstrated a deliberate full-power striking burst followed by a return to half output. At that historical base, half output was about 39,904; that calculation was not a new suppression check. Difficulty sensing a deeply suppressed opponent does not undo Zero’s own suppression skill.

abilities.title: Uncontrolled Dark Factor
abilities.summary: Releases the Dark Factor through an involuntary, dangerous manifestation.
abilities.artworkAlt: Symbolic black-and-violet horned energy eruption for Uncontrolled Dark Factor.
abilities.effect: The attachment can take control of Zero’s body; this is a witnessed manifestation, not a safe voluntary transformation.
abilities.control: Chronoa’s seal contains it. Losing consciousness or nearing death with the channel open can trigger takeover. The failed Kaioken/channel test also triggered it while conscious: Kaioken collapsed and ×15 replaced ×10, without stacking.
abilities.development: Containment remains intact; voluntary mastery has not been achieved.
abilities.appearance: A dense black-and-violet mantle encloses body, hair and clothes, enlarging the silhouette with horn-like projections and pale claws. Reversion exposes the underlying clothes and injuries.

trainingRecord.text: Power erupted after a voice that felt like Zero’s own thoughts offered strength. Fighting Nappa felt dreamlike and apparently voluntary until the body turned toward a city against his wishes. Vegeta stopped him before he reached it. The dense mantle encloses his body, hair and clothes and slightly enlarges his silhouette; reversion reveals what was underneath without repairing battle damage. Its layered growling laugh is not a new technique. This is a recorded manifestation, not a safe transformation he can freely activate. A brief second takeover occurred during the 15 April Kaioken/channel test; Krillin stopped it immediately. Kaioken dropped out, so ×15 replaced the channel without stacking. Chronoa checked and settled the intact seal.

abilities.title: Dark Factor Sealed Channel
abilities.summary: Draws Dark Factor power through Chronoa’s seal while retaining control.
abilities.artworkAlt: A circular four-hook seal containing pale violet energy, symbolising Dark Factor Sealed Channel.
abilities.effect: Opens, regulates and closes the flow through Chronoa’s seal while retaining conscious control.
abilities.control: Consciously regulate the borrowed power. Combining it with Kaioken remains unsafe.
abilities.development: Refining conscious regulation through demanding movement.
abilities.appearance: Pale violet aura and red irises, with ordinary physique and hair colour. The permanent seal is a black circle with four inward-curving hooks below the sternum. The icon is symbolic; the Character gallery carries the full appearance.

trainingRecord.text: Earlier practice through 28 June, Age 854: Voluntary opening and closure developed through supervised practice. Full output reached three moving minutes during the first cleanup week; by 10 March the sequence ended without immediate leg trembling, but still left Zero winded and repeated attempts were tiring. No permanent absorption of the multiplier is established. If he loses consciousness or approaches death while channeling, Uncontrolled Dark Factor takes over: ×15 replaces ×10, rather than stacking. Ordinary sleep with the channel closed is safe. The seal contains the attachment; safe removal remains unresolved. The ability icon is symbolic; the character gallery retains the full appearance reference. Attempting Kaioken on top of the channel caused loss of control even while conscious. The seal itself remained intact after Chronoa’s check; separate channel use resumed. On Namek, Zero defeated Nappa while retaining control, then closed the flow before losing consciousness after Turles’s ambush. Later practice with Vegeta improved recovery without a new timed maximum. Used through the Ginyu Force engagement and confrontation with Frieza. The channel closed while Zero remained conscious; treatment later healed the battle injuries.

Activation, release and movement are possible; no ×3 or higher factor is established. Stacking onto the opened seal triggered Uncontrolled Dark Factor on 15 April. That failed combination is not an available ×20 form. Four further weeks of instruction extended the moving demonstration to one minute. Guru’s release strengthened overall battle capacity, including resilience and endurance. Kaioken proficiency continued to develop through practice. A short ×2 burst injured Brask before his transformation. The latest week improved activation and release while moving; ×2 remains the demonstrated ceiling. Yardrat training improved familiar x2 use. trainingRecord.text: Earlier practice through 28 June, Age 854: Zero named and first attempted it against Nappa on Namek. The first discharge scorched armour; the second tighter pulse breached a small section of already-damaged back armour and burned beneath it. It did not pierce through Nappa or become a sustained beam. The gathered charge is spent on release. During the latest week, a modest gathered charge became repeatable on a moving training approach and contact. The current technique profile records its ×2 regular release and mastery-dependent charge ceiling; those calibrations do not rewrite the earlier partial contacts. Reached Proficient during the final Yardrat fortnight. Used against Frieza: a point-blank clash injured his restricted form, while later contact releases could not overcome his final-form strength.
